subject: Certification orchestration: constraints & timeline Q&A
messages:
From: compliance-ops@acme-bank.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Initial checklist + timeline constraints for ISO/FedRAMP readiness

Hi Rishi / Olga —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We are pulling together our intake for vendor evidence to support our ISO 27001 scope and the FedRAMP readiness path. A couple of quick clarifying questions so we can finalize our procurement timeline: 

1) For ISO 27001, do you have an estimated codefreeze / snapshot window you can commit to for evidence extraction (logs, configuration snapshots, IAM exports)?
2) For FedRAMP readiness, what controls do you expect to require third-party attestations vs. internal artifacts? Any early flags we should budget for (e.g., HSM/KMS attestation, enclave boundaries)?
3) Do you have a short list of control narratives that are still being revised (so we can mark them as "draft" in our intake)?

We referenced your control mapping file when we spoke — could you send the latest? Attached is our proposed audit window (audit_schedule_draft.pdf) to align schedules; we’d appreciate your comments by EOD Thursday so procurement can lock dates.

Thanks,
Linda Hart
Compliance Ops — Acme Bank
compliance-ops@acme-bank.com

[attachment: audit_schedule_draft.pdf]

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: compliance-ops@acme-bank.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial checklist + timeline constraints for ISO/FedRAMP readiness

Linda —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers inline: 

1) Snapshot window: we can commit to a 48-hour snapshot window for logs and config exports. Target week of Oct 12–16. If you need a narrower window for sampling we can do a 24-hour window on Oct 14.

2) Third-party attestations: primary items likely to need 3P evidence are KMS attestation, any HSM-backed key material, and our dedicated network isolation certificates for Private deployments. Most standard controls (patching, MFA, vuln scans, RBAC) we can provide internal artifacts and auditor access.

3) Draft narratives: the following are still in draft status — key rotation policy, ephemeral credential lifecycle, and cache eviction/retention narrative. I’ll attach the control mapping (v1) — it's still a work in progress but should help you triage.

Next steps: Olga will own the artifact intake; Grace will coordinate auditor access windows. Aditya — can you confirm whether the KMS attestation ETA (third-party) is mid-November?

I'll attach control_mapping_v1.xlsx here.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Trust & Security — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

[attachment: control_mapping_v1.xlsx]

From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: compliance-ops@acme-bank.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-13T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial checklist + timeline constraints for ISO/FedRAMP readiness

Hi Linda —

Thanks — small clarifications from our side: 
- The 48-hour snapshot will include host-level logs, orchestration audit trails, and IAM exports. We will not include customer content — all artifacts exclude PII by design.
- For FedRAMP readiness, we anticipate the largest gating items will be KMS/HSM evidence and boundary diagrams for any private deployment customers. If Acme expects evidence around specific regional enclaves, let us know now so we can route a network topology review.

Attached is a lightly annotated control mapping (v1) — I added "draft" flags against the narratives Rishi mentioned. Please treat this as interim; we'll freeze narratives Feb 1 (note: internal freeze date for content owners).

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Compliance Program Manager — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

From: linda.hart@acme-bank.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, linda.hart@acme-bank.com
Date: 2026-09-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial checklist + timeline constraints for ISO/FedRAMP readiness

Thanks — that's helpful. A couple follow-ups: 
• Can you confirm the log retention snapshot format (CSV vs. JSON) and whether you'll provide a parser? Our audit team prefers JSON.
• For KMS: we need confirmation if your customer key flows are covered by a 3P attestation (yes/no). If no, we will require an HSM plan and an expected delivery month.

Also, procurement asked if there's any anticipated cost impact for producing tailored audit bundles or extra auditor read-only access. If you can provide a rough number (hours or $) we can include it in our SOW.

Best,
Linda

Subject: Re: Initial checklist + timeline constraints for ISO/FedRAMP readiness

Linda —

Quick cost/ops note from procurement/ops: producing a dedicated audit bundle (packaging, redact, and delivery in audit format) typically takes ~12–20 engineering hours and 4–6 compliance hours for review. If Acme wants auditor-friendly read-only access to our staging control plane for a 5-day window, there is an estimated incremental infra & support cost of $3,200 (one-time) to cover support coverage and ephemeral environments.

KMS answer: we are pursuing a third-party attestation for the customer key flow; the attestation engagement kickoff is scheduled for 2026-11-08 and target deliverable is end of Q4 (ETA Dec 22, 2026). If that slips we will provide interim HSM design docs and compensating controls.

Log format: we will provide JSON-formatted export and a small parser script. We'll place the parser in the shared Drive folder and link it in the intake ticket.

Action items: 
- Olga: upload annotated control_mapping_v1.xlsx to the Drive folder and tag any controls that require developer action.
- Rishi: confirm freeze week (Oct 12–16) and whether we should spotlight Oct 14 as the 24-hour sample day.
- Linda (Acme): confirm whether procurement needs the cost estimate in USD or as hours so we can produce a formal SOW line item.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Procurement Ops — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
